questions.question: Eight boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and B8 are sitting in a row facing towards the north (not necessarily in the same order). B6 is fifth to the right of B1. B4 is fifth to the right of B5. B5 is to the immediate right of B1. B8 is third to the left of B4. B2 is third to the right of B7. B7 is an immediate neighbour of B1. Who is sitting on the immediate right of B2?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) B6 is fifth to the right of B1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02f1d070ca20f0f00629784edc48e60db08909db08f9545fccc52f21579122c1.png] 

2) B5 is to the immediate right of B1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9947452239bc28c016c9c8310fcbeee1cb76481e6b3b7f423f1c065ffa4fbb0f.png] 

3) B7 is an immediate neighbour of B1.

4) B2 is third to the right of B7.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c03cfc3d6a893aba24ffa7003204f5c28619823727640aa906b131b6a14b968c.png] 

5) B4 is fifth to the right of B5. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f6843ae426a2fe731c90edaac31f456f9f45a3d6239327a661a872e4764e94.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef28ef0c9997d663d9288d305d8f5539c3086a1f675051507d48e3a38950e0c0.png] 

Here, we can see that B8 is sitting on the immediate right of B2.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B8"**.

questions.question: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting around a circular table facing away from the center. U sits exactly between R and S. S sits to the immediate left of T. P is sitting to the immediate right of Q. Who sits to the opposite of T?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) S sits to the immediate left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6749b53cf3f1430e9d198843c9230c499b1758bd04a7eac465553d6f264a30.png] 

2) U sits exactly between R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1d800039bac9fad41b4f50ec98d0d84af3858201c914a110dbc2cfc962de464.png] 

3) P is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32cc92fa98523256eebc65530209a1f48007419212cef8efa6f521635b364dcb.png] 

Here, we can see that R sits to the opposite of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R"**.

1) **+ and ×, 4 and 6**

→ 8 - 6 + **9 ****× 4/3** = 29

→ 20 - 6 = 29

→ 14 ≠ 29

→ **LHS ≠ RHS**
